restitution_schema.pair_bands: pair bands (PR #84) are load-time check assertions only where the impact speed exceeds the 0.5 m/s bounce threshold (env/environment/base_env.py:27); unary overrides reproduce all 20 of #84's pair bands (Wenhao's side review of #73).
